headers.comment: The class video and other media in /assets are large and effectively never change. Files copied from public/ do not get a content hash in their name, so without this they are revalidated on every visit. Supabase served this same video with cache-control: no-cache, which meant every single view re-downloaded all of it and billed the egress again. A year-long immutable cache means a repeat visitor downloads it once, ever. To publish a changed clip, save it under a new filename.
